intro: Your garage door cables lift and lower the door. If a cable frays or breaks, your garage door will not operate correctly. Common signs include the door hanging crooked in the opening or a grinding noise during movement. A loose or wrapped cable off the drum also indicates a problem. Ignoring these issues can cause further damage to your garage door system, or create a safety risk. We provide fast garage door cable repair services across Glenview. Our trucks carry common parts like galvanized aircraft-grade lift cables, cable drums, and bottom brackets. We offer upfront flat-rate quotes before any work starts. We are a family-owned company. Book online for a 10% discount on your service. Our emergency dispatch is available 24 hours Monday through Saturday for urgent repairs.

problemSigns.sign: Door hangs crooked in the opening.
problemSigns.detail: This often means one lift cable is damaged or has come off its drum, causing uneven tension.

problemSigns.sign: Cable hanging loose or wrapped off the drum.
problemSigns.detail: The cable has lost tension or is no longer properly aligned on its spool. This requires immediate attention.

problemSigns.sign: Grinding noise as the door moves.
problemSigns.detail: This sound can indicate a cable rubbing incorrectly, or issues with the cable drum or bearing.

problemSigns.sign: Door slams down faster than normal.
problemSigns.detail: A broken or faulty cable can remove the counterbalancing support, causing the door to drop rapidly and unsafely.
